ops.parking: Mechanical parking for standard-size cars only, underground at the hotel. It is first come, first served and reservations are not accepted. The size limits are height 1.55 m, length 4.8 m and width 1.75 m; for vehicles outside these limits, or when the lot is full, use a nearby paid parking lot. The fee is 400 yen for the first hour, then 200 yen for every 30 minutes. Hours are 9:00-22:00, and vehicles cannot enter or exit outside these hours. A banquet comes with 3 hours of free parking (meeting use is not covered).
ops.catering: The hotel arranges banquet decorations, flowers, sound, lighting, entertainment and the like. If the organizer wants to arrange them directly, the hotel's prior approval is required. For equipment and materials of vendors the organizer hires with the hotel's approval, the hotel gives the vendors instructions on load-in and load-out (Terms of Use for Banquet Rooms).
ops.restaurants: The top floor has Sky Restaurant Hareus. It is open for morning 6:45-10:00 (L.O. 9:30) and lunch 11:00-15:00; dinner is closed for the time being. The private-room plan for enjoying the lunch buffet in a private room is for 20 guests or more, from 15,000 yen (from 18,150 yen including tax and service charge).
